extra_vocab.en: the education, skills, or experience that make a person right for a job
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，Your qualifications 指應徵者的學歷、經歷與能力，給面試官留下好印象，所以進入入圍名單。這種用法在求職信和面試通知裡很常見。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指「資歷」時常用複數 qualifications；後面接 for + 職位（qualifications for the job），不用 of。

example.en: Applicants should attach copies of their qualifications to the form.
example.zh: 應徵者應在表格上附上資歷證明的影本。

example.en: Her academic qualifications include a master's degree in finance.
example.zh: 她的學歷資格包含財務碩士學位。

example.en: Only applicants who meet the qualifications will be contacted.
example.zh: 只有符合資格條件的應徵者才會被聯絡。

example.en: The required qualifications are listed in the job notice.
example.zh: 必備資格列在職缺公告裡。

example.en: A professional qualification in accounting is a big advantage.
example.zh: 擁有會計專業資格是一大優勢。

examples.en: We were impressed by your qualifications and work experience.
examples.zh: 你的資歷和工作經驗讓我們印象深刻。

examples.en: Please list your qualifications at the top of your résumé.
examples.zh: 請把你的資歷列在履歷最上方。

confusable.diff: quality 是「品質、特質」，拼法前半很像，但意思不同。

example.en: The quality of the product is our top priority.
example.zh: 產品品質是我們的第一優先。

similar.diff: skills 指「具體的能力」；qualifications 還包含學歷、證照等正式資格。

example.en: Strong communication skills are important for this job.
example.zh: 良好的溝通能力對這份工作很重要。

similar.diff: background 指整體的「背景、經歷」，範圍比 qualifications 更廣、更不正式。

example.en: He has a strong background in marketing.
example.zh: 他有深厚的行銷背景。

example.en: A college degree is a requirement for this position.
example.zh: 大學學歷是這個職位的必要條件。

example.en: She has five years of experience in sales.
example.zh: 她有五年的業務經驗。

derived.link: 詞幹 qualify（有資格）；去 y 加 -ication 變名詞 qualification
over-（過度）+ qualified，資歷超過職位所需

extra_vocab.en: a person who is being considered for a job or position
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，candidates 指進入徵才流程的「應徵者」。one of five candidates 表示對方是經過初步篩選後，留下的五位人選之一。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: candidate for + 職位或職務（a candidate for the position），不用 candidate of。

example.en: Several candidates asked about the salary during the second interview.
example.zh: 有幾位應徵者在第二輪面試時詢問了薪資。

example.en: Each job candidate will meet the department head.
example.zh: 每位求職者都會見到部門主管。

example.en: She is a strong candidate for the manager position.
example.zh: 她是經理職位的有力人選。

example.en: We have not found a qualified candidate yet.
example.zh: 我們還沒找到合格的人選。

example.en: He is the best candidate for the sales role.
example.zh: 他是業務職位的最佳人選。

examples.en: All candidates must complete a short written test.
examples.zh: 所有應徵者都必須完成一份簡短的筆試。

examples.en: The panel will interview three more candidates tomorrow.
examples.zh: 評審小組明天會再面試三位應徵者。

similar.diff: applicant 是「提出申請的人」，剛投履歷就算；candidate 通常是被考慮或通過篩選的人選。

example.en: More than two hundred applicants sent in their résumés.
example.zh: 超過兩百位應徵者寄來了履歷。

example.en: Every applicant will receive an email reply.
example.zh: 每位申請人都會收到電子郵件回覆。

example.en: The interviewer asked about my previous job.
example.zh: 面試官問了我先前的工作。

example.en: The position will be filled by the end of May.
example.zh: 這個職缺會在五月底前補齊。

senses.en: a person who is being considered for a job

example.en: The top candidate will receive an offer this week.
example.zh: 最優秀的人選本週會收到錄用通知。

senses.en: a person who is trying to win an election or pass an exam
senses.distinguish: 出現 election、vote、exam 等字時，指候選人或考生。

example.en: Each candidate gave a short speech before the vote.
example.zh: 每位候選人在投票前都做了簡短演說。

extra_vocab.en: to put someone on a short list of the best people for a job or prize
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是被動式 have been shortlisted，表示應徵者從所有申請人中，被挑進最後的五人名單。這是徵才信裡的好消息語氣。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: shortlist 多用被動：be shortlisted for + 職位或獎項（被列入…入圍名單）。

forms.label: 第三人稱單數／複數
forms.zh: 列入入圍名單；入圍名單（複數）

example.en: The committee shortlists two vendors after each review round.
example.zh: 委員會在每輪審查後會把兩家廠商列入入圍名單。

example.en: Only four applicants were shortlisted for the final round.
example.zh: 只有四位申請人進入最後一輪的入圍名單。

example.en: Shortlisting takes time because we read every application carefully.
example.zh: 因為我們仔細閱讀每份申請，所以篩選入圍名單很花時間。

example.en: Three engineers were shortlisted for the project leader role.
example.zh: 三位工程師入圍專案負責人的職位。

example.en: We have prepared a shortlist of four suppliers.
example.zh: 我們已準備好四家供應商的入圍名單。

example.en: Only two proposals made the shortlist this year.
example.zh: 今年只有兩份提案進入入圍名單。

example.en: The final shortlist will be announced on Monday.
example.zh: 最終入圍名單會在星期一公布。

examples.en: We are pleased to inform you that you have been shortlisted.
examples.zh: 我們很高興通知你，你已入圍名單。

examples.en: The team shortlisted five applicants out of over one hundred.
examples.zh: 團隊從一百多位申請人中挑出五位入圍。

similar.diff: select 是「挑選」，不一定是從名單中進一步縮小；shortlist 特指挑出少數最佳人選進入下一輪。

example.en: We will select one candidate after the final interview.
example.zh: 最後一輪面試後，我們會選出一位應徵者。

similar.diff: narrow down 較口語，指「把範圍縮小」；shortlist 是正式的徵才或評選用語。

example.en: We need to narrow down the list by Friday.
example.zh: 我們需要在星期五前縮小名單範圍。

example.en: Please select the best option from the list.
example.zh: 請從名單中選出最好的選項。

example.en: The HR team will screen all applications first.
example.zh: 人資團隊會先篩選所有申請。

example.en: The committee shortlisted six companies for the contract.
example.zh: 委員會把六家公司列入合約的入圍名單。

example.en: Your name is on the shortlist for the award.
example.zh: 你的名字在這個獎項的入圍名單上。
